exposure: In vitro fertilization and embryo transfer (IVF-ET)
outcome: Ultrasonographic presentation types of ectopic pregnancy
cohort: The study included 59 cases of heterotopic pregnancy diagnosed by ultrasound and treated at Obstetrics and Gynecology Hospital, Fudan University between February 2013 and April 2017.
finding: Transvaginal color Doppler ultrasound, combined with clinical features, is helpful for the early and accurate detection of heterotopic pregnancy, whose incidence has significantly increased due to assisted reproductive technology and ovulation induction.
